detail.longDescription: Less than 24 hours until #Proxday 2026 kicks off, and I’m already counting down the hours until I can happily welcome all attendees to our event at @credativde@mastodon.social ! There'll be several great talks from Proxmox Server Solutions, NetApp, #PegaProx , credativ with Ceph and Erkan Yanar with CAPI and declarative #Kubernetes Deployment on #Proxmox . Next to this, we'll have some lightning talk from #KASM (for VDI solutions) and #TrueNAS who recently shipped a great storage plugin for Proxmox! During the breaks and the socializing afterwards, I’m happy to have great talks with you about Proxmox, PegaProx, Ceph and virtualization-related topics in general! Run #opensource ! See you tomorrow!
